verdict.rationale: CockroachDB exposes a well-documented SQL/PostgreSQL wire-protocol API and a CLI (ccloud) for managing clusters, plus an MCP server allowing AI tools to query schemas and run queries via OAuth/API key, all documented in official docs. However, no dedicated REST/OpenAPI specification was found (probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s), and there's no independent corroboration of programmatic completeness beyond SQL access. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST API spec, independent verification of API robustness/versioning, and broader ecosystem confirmation of AI-driven API usage beyond docs.
